items.title: Anthropic reported a Claude diary entry to police, triggering a felony charge
items.summary: A Florida woman now faces a felony charge after Anthropic reported a private diary entry she wrote in Claude to police. (1 minute read)

items.title: Reflection AI ships Beam, a 501B open-weight model
items.summary: Reflection AI released Beam, a 501-billion-parameter model, and published its weights. Anyone can now download and run a model at that scale themselves. (1 minute read)

items.title: Google halts its open-source bug bounty program over AI spam
items.summary: Google suspended submissions to its Open Source Software Vulnerability Rewards Program after a flood of AI-generated reports overwhelmed its reviewers. Any OSS maintainer leaning on the program for triage help now has to wait for it to reopen. (1 minute read)

items.title: Opus 5.5 agents flag two room-temperature magnetic semiconductor candidates
items.summary: Opus 5.5 agents reportedly identified two candidate room-temperature magnetic semiconductor materials. (1 minute read)

items.title: Trigger-tag misuse-detection safeguards are fragile, paper finds
items.summary: Trigger-tag mechanisms are meant to flag open-weight models when they're used for things like generating phishing content. A new paper shows these detectable-signal safeguards can be bypassed, undermining a safety approach labs have leaned on for models they don't control post-release. (2 minute read)

items.title: ChatGPT is signing fake New Yorker cartoons with real cartoonists' names
items.summary: ChatGPT's image generator is attaching real New Yorker cartoonists' signatures to cartoons it fabricates in their style. (1 minute read)

items.title: Cloudflare launches a Web Search API
items.summary: Cloudflare introduced a Web Search API, giving developers a direct way to add live web search to agents and RAG pipelines. (1 minute read)

items.title: OpenAI details its approach to EU text-provenance rules
items.summary: OpenAI laid out how it watermarks text to comply with EU provenance rules: where the watermark applies, how detection works, and that detection access starts with researchers rather than the public. It's a concrete look at how one lab plans to meet the EU's traceability requirement. (2 minute read)
